notes.title: Move 78 is Now Available on Steam!
notes.content:
[h1]Move 78 has been released[/h1]

Can you help to guide Sigrid and the others through the mind-bending puzzles of the complex? Solve escape rooms and enjoy a fully-voice story in Move 78.

I want to thank everyone who has supported me during the 2 years of development, today I can finally say the words "The game has been released". It makes me very happy to be able to share the game with everyone finally, I hope you all enjoy your playthroughs. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39397423/39133d9f3a12eeaa9fb92950a5ef36436b7844ba.png[/img]

notes.title: Development Update #1 - Beta Test
notes.content:
First of all, I am sorry for not updating you about the development of the game for so long. I have been hard at work on it all this time and have a near content complete version of Move 78 ready. All that's left is to finish the logic for one mini-game and do a bug sweep. 

Once this is complete, my plan is to hold a beta test (I estimate this build will be ready around 1-2 weeks from now). Once I've fixed any bugs that are found during the test I will be able to set a firm release date for the game.

Here are a few new screenshots:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39397423/f0c367d1380c663f96a742aa010b78b15fa91a4c.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39397423/8ca3fc5e48dae81e8f2fc6aad4726184343d6b88.jpg[/img]

Here's another music track for you guys to check out:

[previewyoutube=9x-hlLlTmAs;full][/previewyoutube]

A little bit of information about what's new since the last update:

[list]
[*]Characters all have multiple expressions when talking.
[*]Logic for all but one of the mini-games is completed.
[*]Logic for all escape room puzzles is completed.
[*]All voice lines have been recorded and added to the game.
[/list]

If you're interested in trying the full version of the game during the beta test, send me a DM over on Twitter [url=https://twitter.com/mjosephs194]here[/url].

Also, if you want to ask any questions, or give feedback on the development of the game you can check out my new discord channel here [url=https://discord.gg/CYYh5sRgNC]here[/url]
